DUNGEON MASTER - Java remake
============================

A fan remake of FTL's Dungeon Master (1988). It needs the data files from
your own copy of the original game: they are copyrighted and not included.


WHERE TO PUT THE GAME FILES
---------------------------

Copy these files from the original game into the "data" folder next to
DungeonMaster.exe:

    data\DUNGEON.DAT    the dungeon (required)
    data\GRAPHICS.DAT   the art and sounds (required for the original look;
                        without it the game runs with simple placeholder art)
    data\SONG.DAT       the entrance music (optional; without it the
                        entrance is silent)

GRAPHICS.DAT and SONG.DAT must come from the PC (DOS) version. DUNGEON.DAT
from the PC version is tested; the Atari ST and Amiga files should also load.

Dungeon Master is abandonware and can be downloaded from My Abandonware:
https://www.myabandonware.com/game/dungeon-master-n0
The files are in the game's folder (sometimes in a DATA subfolder).

The names must match exactly as above. If DUNGEON.DAT is missing, the game
shows a message saying where it looked.


PLAYING
-------

Run DungeonMaster.exe. Java is included; nothing else needs installing.

- Move with the arrow panel on screen, the numeric keypad (7 8 9 turn left,
  forward, turn right; 4 5 6 left, back, right), the arrow keys, or
  W A S D with Q and E to turn.
- Esc opens the game menu: save, load, options and quit.
- Right-click a champion's box to open their character sheet.


SAVED GAMES
-----------

Saved games go in the "saves" folder next to DungeonMaster.exe (4 slots).
To keep them when you install a newer version, copy that folder across.
